about.title: Yards the neighbors stop to look at.
body: Vizcay Landscaping is a landscape contractor based in Vacaville, serving Vacaville, Dixon and the surrounding Solano County area. Nick Vizcay and his crew handle full front and backyard projects, from demolition and concrete removal through pavers, irrigation, turf, plants and bark.
Customers on Yelp give the company 5 stars across 58 reviews, praising great communication, on-time crews, valuable design input and yards left clean and debris-free at the end of each day.

reviews.text: If I could give Nick 100 Five-star ratings I would! He is kind, helpful, creative, hard-working and always shows up in an emergency ( like a missing broken valve that the previous owner buried in a mystery location in our yard!) He installed our landscaping in both our front and back yards. They are so stunning that neighbors walking their dogs stop to tell us they purposely walk down our street so they can see our yard. (BTW if Nick suggests adding lighting... don't hesitate!)
